draftDiscardConfirm: Discard this draft? The entries are lost.
empty: No forms yet — create one with “New form” after the session.
noMatch: No form matches the current filter.
noPermission: You are not enabled to fill in grading forms. An admin can change this in user management.
gradeScale: Grading scale: 5 = above standard · 4 = standard, no debriefing item · 3 = standard, debriefing item · 2 = below standard, additional training · 1 = unsatisfactory, Form 306 required · NO = not observed
signHint: Sign with your finger or a stylus.
lockNote: Once both parties have signed, the form is locked read-only. Corrections require a new entry referencing the original.
readOnlyNote: This form is signed and therefore read-only.
followUpBody: The result is “Not Competent” or the session was not completed. Which forms apply?
errNoTrainee: Please enter a name for every trainee.

admin.trendHint: A competency graded low across the fleet points to a systemic training gap.
admin.competencyHint: Competencies and observable behaviours apply to all forms of the respective set. Changes take effect for new forms immediately.
admin.calibrationHint: Deviation from the overall average. From ±0.40 the value is highlighted (slight deviation), from ±0.80 clearly (worth reviewing) — the same thresholds as in the monthly report. Below 10 grades or 3 sessions nothing is highlighted: any difference there is chance.
admin.exportHint: Unprocessed raw data for audits, separated by training, competencies and people.
admin.deleteCompetencyConfirm: Delete this competency? It disappears from new forms; existing records keep their grades.
admin.newFormHint: New form types get the standard header fields (aircraft type, date, event, training device, flight times). Existing forms keep their data if a type is deleted.
admin.deleteFormTypeConfirm: Delete this form type? It disappears from the selection for new forms; existing forms keep their data.
admin.editOptionsHint: Every dropdown and tick list of this form can be maintained here: rename an entry directly, remove it with ×, or add a new one. Changes apply to new forms immediately.
admin.aircraftCentral: Maintained centrally under Settings → Aircraft types — identical on every form.
admin.noTrendFlags: No trend flags — no competency below the threshold.
admin.statsScopeNote: Basis: only signed forms, follow-up forms excluded, period based on the training date. The standardisation report uses the same scope.
admin.exportListHint: Exports exactly the {{count}} rows the current filters show.
admin.traineesHint: How a pilot develops across sessions — a single 2 is a bad day, the same 2 across three sessions is a finding.
admin.noTrainees: No signed grading sheets with pilots yet.
admin.monthlyHint: Your own gradings for the month, set against the aircraft types you instructed on and against all gradings.
admin.monthlyIntro: The standardisation report answers the ATO's question. This one answers yours: where do I stand?
admin.noMonths: No signed grading sheets with pilots yet.
admin.figuresCaption: Your figures for the month compared with your fleet and with all gradings
admin.flagInsufficient: Too little data for a statement
admin.deltaHint: A positive value means you grade more leniently than the comparison group, a negative one more strictly.
admin.onlyOwn: Your own figures come from your sheets only. The comparison values are aggregates and name nobody.
admin.onlyYou: Only your own sheets in this group — no comparison possible.

attendance307B: With the signature, the instructor/examiner confirms the participation of all individuals listed to the full extent and within the specified timeframe of the respective event.
footnote1: * Tick if any competency is graded 1, or if two or more competencies are graded 2 or below; refer to Form 306 – Additional Training.
footnote2: ** Tick if one or more required items are not completed; describe not completed items in the comment box and Form 310, Deferred Item.
errGradeComment: {{name}}: a comment is mandatory for every competency graded 1 or 2.
errComments: {{name}}: positive aspects, development areas and summary are mandatory.
autoNotCompetent: Automatically Not Competent: one or more competencies graded “1”, or two or more graded “2”.
sessionDataHint: These items are always entered after the grading, at the end of the session.
sigLiveNote: Signatures are never stored or carried over — whenever a signature is required, it must be given live on this device.
retentionHint: Grading sheets remain visible in your view for one week after creation. Admins keep the full record permanently.
deleteOwnConfirm: Remove this grading sheet from your view? It remains stored for admins.
deferredMailNote: Form 310 (Deferred Item) is always emailed to the Training Admin upon completion: {{recipients}}
multiStudentHint: Multiple trainees in one pass are for convenience only: each trainee signs individually, and on completion a SEPARATE form is created for each trainee.
extraRecipientsHint: Standard recipients are configured by the admin. Additional recipients apply to this form only.
sendBlocked: Sending is only possible once the form is complete and correct — still open:
followUpBodyMandatory: The result is “Not Competent” or the session was not completed. The forms marked as mandatory MUST be completed now — the originating grading sheet is attached to their email dispatch automatically.
followUpMailNote: Each follow-up form is emailed to the configured recipients together with the originating grading sheet.
followUpWarn: A mandatory follow-up form has not been completed for this grading sheet yet:
mailAttachment: The originating grading sheet ({{form}}) is automatically attached to the email dispatch of this form.
printHintBody: To save this form as a PDF, tap the button below and choose “Save as PDF” or a printer in the dialog.
printShareFallback: If no dialog opens: use the browser Share menu and choose “Print” there.
trainingAdminNote: Training Admin access: you can view and download all completed and open forms. Creating or removing forms is not possible.

ta.deleteConfirm: Delete this form permanently? Attached follow-up forms are deleted with it.

followUp306PerPilot: One Form 306 per pilot graded “Not Competent” — {{count}} will be opened one after another, each with that pilot’s own deficiencies and signature.
followUp310PerPilot: One Form 310 per pilot — {{count}} will be opened one after another, each naming that pilot and listing the items deferred for them.
errAllNotObserved: At least one competency of {{name}} must carry a grade — a sheet graded “NO” throughout is not a record of competence.
warnFutureDate: The date is in the future. Complete the form anyway?
warnNoFlightTime: A mandatory flight time is 00:00. Complete the form anyway?
errAttendanceSignature: Every attendee on Form 307A signs in person — {{name}} has not signed yet.
leaveConfirm: Leave the form? Your entries are saved as a draft and offered again next time — signatures are not kept.
draftRestored: A draft of this form was restored. Signatures always have to be drawn again.

std.title: Standardisation Report
std.hint: Grading behaviour of each instructor compared with the fleet mean — the basis for standardisation meetings under ORA.ATO.110.
std.footnote: Deviation is the instructor's mean grade minus the fleet mean of the same competency set. Pilot and instructor competencies are never compared with one another. A deviation from {{watch}} grade points is marked for discussion, from {{review}} for review. Marking requires at least {{grades}} grades across at least {{sessions}} sessions; below that a deviation is not meaningful.

deputisedNote: Trainee signature captured on behalf of the assigned instructor by {{name}} — the assigned instructor's account was deactivated.
errNoAttendee: Please add at least one attendee — an attendance record without attendees is not evidence.
typedHint: For use without a pointing device. The document will show the typed name marked as “Typed signature” with a timestamp.
fingerprintBad: DOES NOT match the signed content — this record was altered after signing
